fact: The UN Special Rapporteur noted at the end of her 20-31 January 2025 visit that the offence of defamation of the President had been abolished while criminal libel, insult, seditious practices and hate speech offences remain on the statute books and are actively used.
title: Preliminary Observations by Irene Khan, Special Rapporteur on Freedom of Opinion and Expression, at the end of her visit to Zambia (20-31 January 2025)
